scope: Chapter 4 of the Moin scene prototype (src/story/scenes/04.ts): character lines, replays, waiter chat, lock, oral practice and new story phrases with plurals
notes: Whisper writes numbers as digits (4, 7, 10, 18,30); every such take was compared by hand and says the numbers in words as written.

Hauke's line about Mateo and Greta lost words in every take: OmniVoice fixes the length by the text, and the many short exclamations did not fit. Nine takes of the first wording and three of a second one failed; the final wording with commas ('Greta im Café, Mateo mit Kaffee – Mateo und Greta, ganz klar!') came out complete in all three takes.

For 'Tee? Greta trinkt Cola. …' Whisper heard 'T.' instead of 'Tee?' in two of three takes, and the third ended at -32.2 dB; three more seeds were generated and a take where Whisper hears 'Tee?' and the end is at -43.5 dB was kept.
tails.py passes on all 59 imported files (no fragment after the phrase, no clipped ending).
